author: José Carrillo
abstract: Automated Security Assessment Report (SAR) generator for AI coding agents. Performs deep cybersecurity analysis of codebases, APIs, databases, and infrastructure — producing bilingual (EN/ES) reports with deterministic, auditable scoring, CVSS v4.0 vectors, fix diffs with verification steps, a remediation roadmap, a persistent JSON findings registry (.memory/sar/findings.json), and mappings to 21 baseline compliance standards including ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, and MITRE ATT&CK.
